end.summary:
- Physical change was practised: Ananya identified melting ice and ghee as changes where the substance remains the same; a why or new-situation question is still to check.
- Everyday changes were practised; some classifications were right, but the evidence-based rule is not steady yet.
- Ananya initially treated melting ice as chemical, then corrected this at turn 6.
- Ananya initially used reversibility as the rule; by turn 11, they recognised that ash from a sparkler is a new substance and that reversibility is only a clue.
- Examples discussed included burning a sparkler, cutting paper, melting ghee, frying besan and curdling milk.
end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying physical and chemical changes with Ananya using the evidence of whether a new substance forms. Ananya corrected the melting-ice mix-up during the lesson and later used ash, smell and colour change as evidence for chemical change; they still need practice applying the rule consistently rather than relying on reversibility alone. At home, ask Ananya to classify three everyday changes and explain whether a new substance forms, including one case where reversal is possible and one where it is not.

Aap keh rahe hain tape se tukde judte hain, jaise dahi fridge mein doodh ban jaaye. Par tape lagane par bhi kaagaz mein phatne ki lakeer rehti hai; aur dahi thandi dahi hi rehti hai. Dono mein se kaagaz phaadte waqt kya koi naya padarth banta hai?

haan, kaagaz phaadne se naya padarth banta hai... jaise dahi jamta hai na doodh se, waise hi kaagaz ke chhote chhote pieces ban jaate hain, aur woh alag cheez hai. par agar fridge mein rakho toh dahi wapas doodh ban sakta hai, toh shayad kaagaz ke tukde bhi fridge mein rakho toh wapas poori kaagaz ban sakti hai... pata nahi, par chemical badlav hi lagega mujhe toh

Aapko lag raha hai ki chhote tukde nayi cheez hain aur fridge unhein jod dega. Par kaagaz ko phaadne se pehle aur baad mein, dono kaagaz hi hain; fridge mein rakhne se tukde judte nahi, jaise dahi doodh nahi banti. Ab poster ko kaatne aur sparkler jalne mein, chemical badlav kaunsa hai, aur sirf ulta na kar paana kaafi saboot kyun nahi?

sparkler jalna chemical change hai kyunki woh raakh ban jaata hai, aur aapne kaha na ulta nahi kar sakte... par actually sparkler bhi chemical nahi hoga kyunki usse fridge mein rakho toh phir se sparkler ban sakta hai, jaise dahi fridge mein doodh ban jaata hai. aur poster kaatna physical hai kyunki tape se chipka sakte hain. par reversibility proof nahi hai kyunki ande ko ubaal ke fridge mein rak

Aapne poster kaatne ko physical kaha, aur sparkler se raakh banne ka saboot bhi diya; phir fridge wali baat par shaq hua. Fridge thanda karta hai, lekin raakh ko sparkler ya dahi ko doodh nahi banata. Poster ke tukde kaagaz hi hain, jabki jalne par raakh banti hai. Toh poster kaatna aur sparkler jalna alag tarah ke badlav kyun hain?

sparkler jalna hi chemical change hai... kyunki uska raakh ban jaata hai na, aur woh sparkler se alag hai. poster kaatna toh bas kaagaz ke tukde hai, woh raakh nahi ban raha... yeh wali line padh lo, 'nae padarth bante hain' — sparkler mein raakh naya padarth hai, isliye chemical. reversibility ka sochke main uljhan mein thi, par ab pata chala fridge wali baat sahi nahi thi. kadhai mein aloo dikha

Bilkul, sparkler mein raakh naya padarth hai; poster ke tukde ab bhi kaagaz hain. Fridge wali uljhan bhi aapne suljha li. Aapne kadhai mein aloo bola; aloo pakne par kaunsa badlav hoga, aur kaunsa saboot dekhengi?

kitchen mein... mithai banate time, jaise ghee pighalta hai na, woh physical badlav hai kyunki woh wapas jam sakta hai, ghee hi rahega. aur chemical badlav hai... jab besan ko fry karte hain na, tab woh brown ho jaata hai, ekdum alag smell aati hai, toh naya padarth ban gaya na, jaise raakh ban gaya tha sparkler mein. yeh hua na?

Haan, mithai wala example sahi direction mein hai: ghee pighalne par ghee hi rehta hai, aur besan bhunne par rang aur khushboo badalte hain. Rang ya smell ek sanket hai; pakka faisla naya padarth banne par hota hai. Ab doodh khatta hokar phat jaaye toh woh physical hoga ya chemical, aur aapka saboot kya hai?

chemical badlav hoga. kyunki usmein ekdum khatti smell aati hai na, aur doodh phat ke jo chunks ban jaate hain, woh doodh se bilkul alag lagte hain. aur fridge mein rakhne se bhi woh wapas doodh nahi ban sakta, jaise aapne pehle bataya tha ki dahi se doodh wapas nahi hota.

Aapne chemical badlav kaha; khatti smell aur phate hue doodh ka badalna achchhe saboot hain. Fridge se wapas na banna ek clue hai, lekin main baat naya padarth banna hai. Ab jab namak paani mein hilaate hain, Kunal use pighalna kehta hai; sahi shabd kya hoga, aur pighalne se kaise alag hai?
